columns.name: id

columns.definition_sql: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()

columns.name: org_id

columns.name: course_id
columns.description: 上游 course.id；通过复合 FK 与 org_id 绑定

columns.description: 发起任务的同组织安全主体；回调时仍重验当前权限

columns.description: 调用幂等键；唯一范围见表约束，同键异 hash 返回 409
columns.definition_sql: idempotency_key text NOT NULL CHECK (length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

columns.description: 规范化输入清单的 SHA-256；用于重复请求冲突和重算追踪

columns.description: 任务已产出对象编号/版本；不存正文
columns.definition_sql: result_refs jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(result_refs)='object')

columns.description: 受控生命周期状态；API仍须验证允许转移与权限

columns.description: 允许的最大尝试/运行次数；语义取决于所属表
columns.definition_sql: max_attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 3 CHECK (max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 10)

columns.description: 单调递增执行代次；租约和取消的 fencing token
columns.definition_sql: execution_epoch bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (execution_epoch >= 0)

columns.name: lease_until
columns.description: worker 租约截止时间；回调必须匹配当前 epoch 和有效状态

columns.name: not_before
columns.description: 任务允许再次领取的最早时间
columns.definition_sql: not_before timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

columns.name: error_code
columns.description: 可公开的结构化故障码，不含密码、提示或答案全文

columns.name: budget_limit
columns.description: 任务允许成本上限；不等同于完整计费账务
columns.definition_sql: budget_limit numeric(14,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (budget_limit >= 0)

columns.name: budget_spent
columns.description: 已记录成本；0 到 budget_limit，币种/计价单位由策略固定
columns.definition_sql: budget_spent numeric(14,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (budget_spent >= 0 AND budget_spent <= budget_limit)

columns.name: cancelled_at
columns.description: 取消时间；仅 cancelled 状态必填

columns.name: completed_at
columns.description: 终态完成时间，由任务服务维护

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: 记录创建时间，UTC timestamptz
columns.definition_sql: created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: 允许状态或草稿的最近保存时间，UTC timestamptz
columns.definition_sql: updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

constraints_sql: CHECK (status <> 'running' OR lease_until IS NOT NULL)
indexes_sql: CREATE INDEX ix_task_claim ON ea.task_run(not_before,created_at) WHERE status IN ('queued','running');
CREATE INDEX ix_task_course ON ea.task_run(org_id,course_id,status,created_at DESC);

columns.description: 形成笔记证据时有效的 profile_use 同意；不能使用共享同意

columns.name: source_type
columns.description: effective_grade/consented_note/observation；决定可用 FK
columns.definition_sql: source_type text NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('effective_grade','consented_note','observation'))

columns.name: provenance
columns.description: 数据来源标识：真实/演示/人工示例/模拟等；不能相互冒充
columns.definition_sql: provenance text NOT NULL CHECK (provenance IN ('real','demo','manual_example','simulated'))

columns.name: judgment_source
columns.description: rule/model/teacher/self_report；不能推断为真实学习增益
columns.definition_sql: judgment_source text NOT NULL CHECK (judgment_source IN ('rule','model','teacher','self_report'))

columns.name: source_event_key
columns.description: 源事件的稳定幂等标识，按组织+知识点去重
columns.definition_sql: source_event_key text NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_event_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

columns.name: summary
columns.description: 证据摘要；不包含完整答案、笔记或私聊全文
columns.definition_sql: summary jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(summary)='object')

columns.name: observed_at
columns.description: 原始证据发生时间，区别于入库创建时间

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: 记录创建时间，UTC timestamptz
columns.definition_sql: created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

constraints_sql:
CHECK ((source_type='effective_grade' AND grade_revision_id IS NOT NULL AND note_permission_id IS NULL) OR
         (source_type='consented_note' AND note_permission_id IS NOT NULL AND grade_revision_id IS NULL) OR
         (source_type='observation' AND grade_revision_id IS NULL AND note_permission_id IS NULL))
indexes_sql: CREATE INDEX ix_evidence_student ON ea.evidence_event(org_id,course_id,student_id,observed_at DESC);

tables.name: ea.profile_version
tables.purpose: 课程内学习状态成功版本，明确规则统计和研究原型边界

columns.name: id
columns.description: 扩展对象主键；除审计为 BIGINT identity 外均为 UUID
columns.definition_sql: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()

columns.name: org_id
columns.description: 上游 organization.id；所有组织范围判断的显式维度

columns.name: course_id
columns.description: 上游 course.id；通过复合 FK 与 org_id 绑定

columns.name: student_id
columns.description: 上游 user.id；业务学生身份，必须由会话/对象关系确定
columns.definition_sql: student_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES public."user"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: version
columns.description: 从 1 开始的逻辑版本号，不能覆盖已有版本

columns.name: previous_version_id
columns.description: 同一版本链前驱；NULL 表示首版

columns.name: trigger_type
columns.description: 画像触发类型：grade_effective/grade_corrected/note_evidence/consent_revoked/rebuild
columns.definition_sql: trigger_type text NOT NULL CHECK (trigger_type IN ('grade_effective','grade_corrected','note_evidence','consent_revoked','rebuild'))

columns.name: trigger_event_key
columns.description: 稳定领域事件键；同学生课程方法下去重，允许无新成绩的撤权重算
columns.definition_sql: trigger_event_key text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trigger_event_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

columns.name: trigger_grade_id
columns.description: 评分生效/更正触发必填有效成绩版本；其他触发类型为空

columns.name: task_id
columns.description: 相关同组织/课程 task_run；没有异步任务的事实允许为空

columns.name: method_kind
columns.description: rule_statistics 或 research_prototype，明确产品统计/研究原型边界
columns.definition_sql: method_kind text NOT NULL CHECK (method_kind IN ('rule_statistics','research_prototype'))

columns.name: capability_status
columns.description: connected/not_connected/unvalidated；接通不等于效果已验证
columns.definition_sql: capability_status text NOT NULL CHECK (capability_status IN ('connected','not_connected','unvalidated'))

columns.name: method_version
columns.description: 状态或推荐算法/原型版本，纳入幂等范围

columns.name: provenance
columns.description: 数据来源标识：真实/演示/人工示例/模拟等；不能相互冒充
columns.definition_sql: provenance text NOT NULL CHECK (provenance IN ('real','demo','manual_example','simulated','mixed'))

columns.name: evidence_manifest
columns.description: [{evidence_id,...}]；DB逐项检查同学生课程组织，服务检查有效/撤销状态
columns.definition_sql: evidence_manifest jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(evidence_manifest)='array')

columns.name: states
columns.description: 知识点UUID到状态对象映射，state仅good/bad/unknown/conflict；禁止虚构百分比
columns.definition_sql: states jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(states)='object')

columns.name: research_fields
columns.description: 研究字段对象；每项必须含status/source/method_version，规则统计时必须为空
columns.definition_sql: research_fields jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(research_fields)='object')

columns.name: input_hash
columns.description: 规范化输入清单的 SHA-256；用于重复请求冲突和重算追踪

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: 记录创建时间，UTC timestamptz
columns.definition_sql: created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

constraints_sql: CHECK ((version=1 AND previous_version_id IS NULL) OR (version>1 AND previous_version_id IS NOT NULL))

CHECK ((trigger_type IN ('grade_effective','grade_corrected') AND trigger_grade_id IS NOT NULL) OR
         (trigger_type IN ('note_evidence','consent_revoked','rebuild') AND trigger_grade_id IS NULL))
indexes_sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_profile_root ON ea.profile_version(org_id,course_id,student_id) WHERE previous_version_id IS NULL;
